questions.question: In what order should the token-saving changes be finished before the BK-389 kernel work?

options.label: BK-431 → small → BK-389 (Recommended)
options.description: Land the smaller reviewer input, measure a delivery about BUG-280's size (e.g. BUG-300) against run B, then measure BK-389. The changes are confirmed before the big work starts. Costs one extra small delivery.

options.label: BK-431 → BK-389
options.description: Land the smaller reviewer input, then measure BK-389 directly. Gets to the kernel sooner, but BK-389 is the first test of the finished changes, with no comparable baseline.

options.label: BK-389 now, measured
options.description: Measure BK-389 with the changes as they are, and decide BK-431 from that run. Fastest, but it measures an older process on the riskiest work.

options.label: BK-389 unmeasured
options.description: Keep the kernel out of the experiment. Do BK-389 normally and take a different item for measuring. Separates the risks, but the measurement loses its most realistic subject.

questions.question: What should BK-431's smaller reviewer input be? (Run B's review subagents carried: shared prefix 39%, PR content 19%, process files 13%, of which the rvw-pr skill file was 11.6%.)

options.label: Agent type + mode split (Recommended)
options.description: Add a reviewer agent (tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash) that /ship spawns for every pass. Split rvw-pr so the measuring block and Step 4 posting sit in files only those modes read. Targets both measured costs, and the frontmatter enforces 'no Edit/Write' (ship's permissions block changes). Prefix saving is measured in a fresh session before the PR, because agent types load only at startup.

options.label: Reviewer agent type only
options.description: Only the restricted-tool reviewer agent. Smallest diff, and rvw-pr's many cross-references stay intact. Leaves the 11.6% skill-file share alone.

options.label: rvw-pr mode split only
options.description: Only move the measuring and posting parts out of the core file. No new agent type and no restart needed to measure, but the prefix (the largest share) is untouched.

options.label: Measure first, no change
options.description: This PR only adds the per-subagent split to the kit (hypothesis 3's test as a tool) and records run B's numbers. The input change comes in a later PR.

questions.question: Approve this BK-431 plan?
/ship now says every pass spawns as `reviewer`, but ADR-0036 and three places in /ship still have a domain persona (or general-purpose) staff a lens. Which rule wins?

options.label: Persona stays, rest reviewer (Recommended)
options.description: Solo passes and unstaffed members (the general-purpose case /ship calls normal) spawn as reviewer. A member staffed by a persona keeps that persona's type and its full tools, with read-only restated in its prompt. ADR-0036 is untouched. The Reader lens text and 'every pass' get narrowed to match. Smallest change; the saving covers the normal case.

options.label: Always reviewer, lens via brief
options.description: Every member spawns as reviewer; a persona's foundation docs go into the brief instead of its agent type. Strongest tool restriction and prefix saving, but it withdraws ADR-0036's staffing clause for /ship. Accepted ADRs are immutable, so it needs a new record, and the PR grows.

options.label: Drop panel adoption
options.description: Only solo /rvw-pr passes run as reviewer (via agent:); panels keep spawning as today. No conflict with ADR-0036, but panel members, most of run B's subagent spend, get no saving.

questions.question: Should reviewer.md stop mentioning DOMAIN: and ADR-0036? Round 2's new reviewer ran 6 empty searches that look prompted by that text.

options.label: Trim to the pointer (Recommended)
options.description: Keep only: run one pass, your instructions are rvw-pr/SKILL.md. Move the 'tool container, not a persona' rationale into /ship's Reviewer permissions block, which subagents only read when reviewing /ship. Fewer bytes per pass, and less to prompt detours.

options.label: Keep as is
options.description: The rationale stays next to the tool list; accept the possible extra searches. One run is weak evidence they were caused by the text.
